shapes.text: a good method for this is to use the portal and then go to the opposite team . also look at the summoning familiars . the next winning team will have the most powerful monsters such as steel titan in the waiting box . without helping out you can get kicked out . do things like kill pyre fiends or jellies . when killing these , they drop soul shards , which you ca use on the soul obelisk if your team is in control . you can also kill other players , or the boss if your slayer level is above the bosses level .
